items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I had Floyd O'Bryan and different trumpet players.

ctx.x: That was 5900 North Broadway on Thorndale, I think it was, right around the corner. And tremendous, we packed the joint. And I had Floyd O'Bryan and different trumpet players. I had little Muggsy Davis I had Jimmy Isle for awhile, different people.
